build_pipeline_caching_neighbors: build a pipeline that caches nearest neighbors graph between multiple classifier fits using KNeighborsTransformer and KNeighborsClassifier
run_grid_search_tuning_neighbors: run GridSearchCV on a cached pipeline to tune n_neighbors hyperparameters for KNeighborsClassifier
create_kneighbors_transformer_graph: create a KNeighborsTransformer with mode distance to precompute the nearest neighbors graph for a dataset
create_kneighbors_classifier_precomputed: create a KNeighborsClassifier with precomputed metric to use a precomputed nearest neighbors graph
summarize_grid_search_results_plot: summarize GridSearchCV results by plotting classification accuracy and fit time against n_neighbors values
